## Checklist

- [ ] No new runtime dependency.
- [ ] Function names and result keys unchanged (results use the exact keys of the test cases).
- [ ] TypeScript and Python stay in step (a change in one port is made in the other, or the issue says why not).
- [ ] User-facing strings have no em dash; text in three languages (vi, en, zh) where the result carries names.
- [ ] README examples still print what they say, if this changes a result.
